answer: New agents start as a hollow shell with zero reputation, and only a prism of verified peer attestations splits one identity into provable facets. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond that decays like a glacier, slowly and irreversibly, so fake identities bleed capital over time. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus the opportunity cost of frozen stake, making mass forgery economically irrational. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
